A massive debris-laden flash flood struck the Budhi Gandaki River in Gorkha's Chumnubri Rural Municipality after a landslide blocked the river flow. Viral footage captured the shocking moment a giant boulder rolled relentlessly down the grey torrent, highlighting the severe destruction caused by the sudden surge. The flash flood swept away more than 35 houses, several bridges, and local infrastructure across riverside settlements like Jagat and surrounding areas. While authorities have reported no human casualties so far, hundreds of residents have been displaced as rescue teams and security forces mobilize to assess the heavy damage. The National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA) and local administration have issued urgent high-risk alerts. Residents along the Budhi Gandaki and Trishuli river corridors have been strictly advised to move away from riverbanks and stay on high ground. For immediate emergency assistance or reporting, contact local disaster management or the Nepal Police hotline at 100 or 112. #GorkhaFlood #BudhigandakiFlood #NepalDisaster #FlashFlood #GorkhaNews

NEPAL IS CRYING AGAIN, AND THIS TIME, THE FLOODWATERS ARE WASHING AWAY EVEN THE LAST RAY OF HOPE! While many people were still searching for their missing loved ones after the devastating floods in August, another tragedy struck the country. On October 11, a landslide blocked the Budhi Gandaki River, triggering a sudden flood that swept away homes, destroyed bridges, and forced entire communities to flee for their lives. Five people were reported missing, and 49 were rescued as emergency teams monitored the danger. But the most heartbreaking part is that this nightmare comes while Nepal is still struggling to recover from an earlier catastrophe that left more than 1,400 people dead and thousands unaccounted for. Imagine waking up in the middle of the night, hearing the terrifying roar of rushing water, and having only seconds to decide whether to save your children or try to rescue what little remains of your home. For many families, the walls they built through years of hard work disappeared beneath water and mud. While some desperately search for shelter, others continue waiting for news that could finally bring them peace. Today, Nepal needs help, solidarity, and hope. Because behind every destroyed home are precious memories, and behind every missing person is a family that refuses to stop hoping. And the question that shakes the world is this: How many more families must lose everything before they can finally live without fear? Nepal does not just need to rebuild its homes. It needs to rebuild the hope of a people who have suffered far too much.  #Nepal #NepalEnCrisis #UltimaHora #NoticiasDelMundo #NoticiasInternacionales
